event_confirmation: Centene press release 2026-10-19: Q3 2026 results at approx. 6:00 a.m. ET Tuesday 2026-10-27, call 8:30 a.m. ET (bmo). Window: close 2026-10-26 to close 2026-10-27. https://finviz.com/news/404279/centene-corporation-to-host-2026-third-quarter-financial-results-earnings-call ; https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/centene-centene-corporation-to-host-2026-third-quarter-financial-results-earnings-call-20261019 (MarketScreener's 2026-11-06 date is wrong).
conviction_note: The evidence is balanced. Peer prints after Centene last spoke point to a Q3 beat: Elevance said July 1 Medicaid rates came in stronger and ACA deductible costs are arriving more slowly, Molina was in line and constructive on 2027 rates, and UNH beat and raised. Against that, the stock is up 13.5% in a month to within 5% of its 52-week high, puts are bid (skew +5.05), and the call is where management promised '2027 clarity', against a FY2027 street of $5.35 that has to absorb about $0.50 of non-recurring 2026 settlements and Medicaid recovery muted by OB3. The findings sum to 0.0 and p_up is 51 on abs 8.5, so the two measurements agree that the sign is a coin flip. abs is set above the 7.7 implied move because this is the first print with 2027 framing and the name moved 12.5% and 14% on its last two framing-heavy beats.
bar: Q3 2026 adj EPS: Benzinga consensus $0.09 (another Benzinga page shows $0.08), revenue $46.97B to $47.21B (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CNC/earnings-forecasts). It matches the company's own cadence from the Q2 call: Q3 'a little above breakeven', Q4 a loss (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-27-centene-co-stock/). FY2026 guide is adj EPS > $4.80, reaffirmed 2026-09-16 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1071739/000107173926000172/cnc-20260916.htm), against a street of $4.88. FY2027 street is $5.35 from one source only (StockAnalysis/S&P, updated 2026-10-07, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cnc/forecast/), so the findings that depend on 2027 are capped. print_vs_bar_pct is on revenue.
positioning_check: Short interest is not crowded: 14.67M shares as of 2026-05-29, about 2.75% of float, 3.56 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/cnc/short-interest). No October settlement was found. Skew is +5.05 vol points (puts bid). Put/call OI ratio is 0.59. Stock is +8.7% over 20 days (+13.5% over 30 days per StockStory and Simply Wall St), 4.6% below its 52-week high and 114% above its 52-week low. The options are paying for downside into a run-up.

findings.finding: Elevance's Q3 2026 print (Oct 21, after Centene last spoke on 2026-09-16) says July 1 state Medicaid rate updates came in stronger than expected, and it raised its 2026 Medicaid margin to slightly better than -1.75%. It also kept more ACA members than planned (≥1.2M vs 1.0M) and says deductible-related costs are arriving more slowly. Molina's Q3 (Oct 21) had Medicaid MCR 93.0% and Marketplace MCR 92.5%, both 'in line', and reaffirmed guidance. UNH (Oct 13) beat at $4.69 vs about $4.14 and raised. Centene's own Q2 call said the 7/1 rate cohort (about 20% of Medicaid members) gives a Q2-to-Q3 sequential benefit, and guided Q3 to 'a little above breakeven' against a street of about $0.09. The read-through points to a Q3 above that bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: $2.51 vs about $1.02-1.09 consensus with a raise, stock -0.27% (sold on the Medicaid-margin outlook). Q1 2026: $3.37, about $0.50 above expectations, stock +13.95%. Q3 2025: beat and raise, +12.5%. A quarter beat pays only when the outlook is not dimmed.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 street ($0.08-0.09) and revenue ($47B) were 'generally unchanged over the last 30 days' per StockStory, so the estimates have not absorbed the peer prints. The stock has, though: +13.5% in a month. That is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Molina 8-K Q3 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000042/moh3q26_er.htm) and UNH Q3 2026 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000731766/000073176626000255/earningsrelease3q26unh.htm) are separate documents. The Elevance document is shared with finding 3 (Medicaid 2027 rates), which lands on a different line.

findings.finding: The 2027 ACA marketplace has competitors leaving and rates going up while Centene holds its footprint. Cigna, Molina, CareSource, Baylor Scott & White and Providence are exiting, which affects 'hundreds of thousands' of enrollees. Centene adds 55 counties in AL, IA, IL, LA, MI, NJ and TX and exits DE and NH, net flat on 3.5M+ enrollees. KFF puts the median proposed 2027 premium increase at about 15%. On the Q2 call management said it would give 'more clarity on the Q3 call' on 2027 marketplace positioning and margin restoration.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Marketplace is the line that broke the stock: the 2025-07-01 risk-adjustment pull was -40.37%. Marketplace margin raised from 3% to 4.5-5% at Q2 2026 (-0.27%, offset by the Medicaid outlook). Commentary in March 2026 that ACA membership would fall was followed by about -18%.
findings.why_not_priced: The footprint is public, but how much of the competitor exits Centene captures, and at what margin, only comes out when management speaks on the call. If it were priced, the 2027 revenue consensus ($192.75B) would not sit below 2026 ($195.9B). Partly priced through the run-up.
findings.independence: KFF 2027 rate-filing analysis (https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/how-much-and-why-aca-marketplace-premiums-are-going-up-in-2027/) is a separate source. Simply Wall St 2026-10-25 on Ambetter's 2027 plan expansion (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/healthcare/nyse-cnc/centene/news/centene-cnc-could-be-2-undervalued-after-ambetter-expands-20).

findings.finding: Both Medicaid peers that reported after Centene last spoke are constructive on 2027 Medicaid rates. Molina's CEO: 'the strength of recent rate updates for 2027 ... we believe we are likely observing the beginning of the turn in Medicaid margins.' Elevance is 'encouraged by early 2027 rates', calls 2026 the trough, and describes Medicaid as 'moving from stabilization to improvement'. Centene's Q2 call said OB3 would 'mute' its Medicaid recovery into 2027, with acceleration only in H2 2027, which is the line it was sold on in July. Peer evidence of strong 1/1/2027 rates gives the Q3 call room to firm that language.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-28: beat and raise but 'Centene Slides On Dimming Outlook for Medicaid Profit Margins' (Bloomberg Law), -0.27% on the day. Medicaid is about 51% of premium revenue ($22.8B of $44.4B in Q2).
findings.why_not_priced: Centene's own last word on 2027 Medicaid (July 28 and the Sept 16 reaffirmation) predates these peer statements. Molina reportedly fell after its print despite the 2027 comment (about -8.5% per goldesel.de, unverified), so the market has not rewarded the language at a peer. This is a proxy, because states differ.
findings.independence: Elevance Q3 2026 via Healthcare Dive (https://www.healthcaredive.com/news/elevance-medicaid-momentum-q3-2026-elv/833559/). That document is shared with finding 1, but the statement used there is about the reported quarter.

findings.finding: Centene's 2027 Medicare Star Ratings (released by CMS around Oct 9, 2026) fell: Stephens puts 9% of members in 4+ star plans vs 18% for 2026, and Becker's has the unweighted average down from 3.31 to 3.14. Industry-wide, 4+ star enrollment rose from about 64% to 71%. This cuts 2028 MA quality bonuses and makes the 'MA breakeven or better in 2027, margin improvement after' path harder. Management flagged Stars as a risk on the Q2 call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sept 2025: preliminary Stars 'in line' with a slightly higher 4-star share moved the stock up sharply (Bloomberg Law 2025-09-11). The MA segment is about 1M members and small next to Medicaid and PDP.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and the stock rose about 13% after it, so it is mostly priced. What remains is whether management quantifies a 2028 headwind on the call. It affects 2028, so only a small piece can move this window.
findings.independence: Becker's '8 things to know about 2027 MA star ratings' (https://www.beckerspayer.com/?p=29667), which reports the same direction (3.31 to 3.14).

findings.finding: The 2026-to-2027 bridge is demanding against a single-source FY2027 street of $5.35, which is +10% on the FY2026 street of $4.88 and about +22% once the roughly $0.50 of 2026 non-recurring Q2 settlements is removed ($180M marketplace risk adjustment, $160M Medicare), which management said will not recur. Management also said OB3 will 'mute' Medicaid margin recovery 'through the back half of 2026 and into 2027'. Expansion members are about 18% of Medicaid by year-end, with mid-single-digit attrition expected over 2027-28. CMS's RIA for the June 2026 work-requirement IFR projects -2.3M Medicaid enrollment in FY2027, and requirements start 2027-01-01. The PDP premium stabilization demo ends after 2026. The Q3 call is where management promised 2027 detail.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First guides and outlook framing are the name's big movers: the initial 2026 guide in Feb 2026 moved -3.66%, Q2 2026 -0.27% on a muted Medicaid outlook despite the raise, the 2025-07-01 withdrawal -40.37%, and the Q3 2025 framing +12.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the street had absorbed the bridge, FY2027 EPS would sit near $4.4-4.9, not at $5.35, and the stock would not be 4.6% from its high after +13.5% in a month. The skew (+5 puts bid) suggests options already hedge some of this. The bar is single-source, so this is capped.
findings.independence: Consensus from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cnc/forecast/ (S&P, 2026-10-07). OB3 work-requirement IFR and enrollment RIA: https://www.healthcarefinancenews.com/news/cms-releases-interim-final-rule-work-requirements-medicaid. Both are separate documents. This partly offsets finding 3; they are kept apart because one is peer rate evidence and the other is Centene's own bridge arithmetic.

findings.finding: On Oct 8, 2026 Centene called its entire remaining $568.7M of 4.25% notes due Dec 2027 for redemption at par on Oct 23, paid from cash. This is deleveraging ahead of the print and signals comfort with parent liquidity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this line. In March 2026 there were also note redemptions with no measurable reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public. The only new piece is whether Q3 cash flow and parent cash, after the redemption, support buybacks being discussed on the call. Nearly zero.

findings.finding: CFO transition: Drew Asher steps down as CFO in December 2026, and Chris Neczypor (ex-Lincoln National CFO) joined as EVP around Sept 1 and becomes CFO on 2027-01-01. The outgoing CFO frames 2027 on this call, and the incoming CFO will own the December/February guide. That is a mild incentive for a conservative 2027 framing, which is uncertain in sign.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-17 announcement had no notable move in the tape.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public. It is filed only as context for how 2027 will be framed.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is extended. The stock is +13.5% over 30 days against +2.7% for health insurers, +8.7% over 20 days, 4.6% below its 52-week high, +68% YTD, and above the $71.78 average target on some days ($68-71 against a $56-85 range). 25-delta skew is +5.05 (puts bid), and estimates were flat over 30 days. A Q3 beat is partly in the price, and the skew asks for a 2027 framing that clears the run-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after a strong run (+3.2% sector rebound days in July) and a large beat, and the stock moved -0.27%.
findings.why_not_priced: Run-up and skew are the price itself. This is filed so the panel sees that the bar has moved above the published consensus. Short interest is about 2.75% of float, so the run-up is not a squeeze.
findings.independence: Simply Wall St 2026-10-25 (+13.51% over 30 days, https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/healthcare/nyse-cnc/centene/news/centene-cnc-could-be-2-undervalued-after-ambetter-expands-20), plus the sealed baseline (skew +5.05, run_up_20d +8.7).

findings.finding: Florida's medically complex children's Medicaid contract, previously Sunshine Health's (Centene) Children's Medical Services plan, goes to Molina. Molina guides a $1.50/share implementation loss in Q4 2026 for the new Florida contract. Centene loses that premium from Q4 2026 into 2027, a 2027 revenue headwind. Sunshine chose not to protest.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Florida awards in 2025 (Centene kept statewide) moved the stock up. No reaction to the CMS-children loss was found.
findings.why_not_priced: It is known since Nov 2025 and probably in the FY2027 revenue consensus ($192.75B, below 2026). Only the size of the drag in Centene's 2027 bridge is new.
findings.independence: Molina Q3 2026 8-K mentions the Florida Q4 2026 implementation loss (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000042/moh3q26_er.htm).

outside_window.finding: Medicaid work requirements start 2027-01-01 (CMS IFR June 2026, RIA -2.3M enrollment in FY2027). The actual membership loss shows up in 2027 quarters, and only the guidance framing is inside this window (folded into finding 5).
Formal 2027 guidance and the 2026-to-2027 bridge: management said 'in a couple of quarters', typically at the December investor day or the February Q4 print.

baseline_tension: Peer evidence leans positive on the quarter and on 2027 Medicaid rates, which cuts against the +5 put skew. The 20- and 30-day run-up and a $5.35 FY2027 street that has to absorb $0.50 of non-recurring items agree with the skew. Net, nothing beats the baseline, so p_up sits at 51.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the Q3 reported-quarter finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.7, because the Q2 2026 beat-and-raise traded -0.27%.
Rule 6 (verify the bar): the FY2027 bar ($5.35) has one source, so the 2027-bridge finding was capped from -1.5 to -1.0.
Rule 5 (proxy): the peer 2027 Medicaid-rate read-through is state-dependent and not confirmed by Centene, so it went from +0.8 to +0.6.
Rule 7 (positioning): the negative positioning finding agrees with the skew and short interest is not crowded (about 2.75%). Trimmed from -0.5 to -0.4 as mostly in the price.
Rule 4 (financing): the debt redemption is funded from cash, deleveraging, so the sign stays positive and near zero, unchanged.
p_up moved from 52 to 51 because the baseline tension (run-up plus skew against peer read-through) is unresolved, and abs_move_pct stays at 8.5.
